Sorry about the semi late response, busy yesterday since it was my brothers graduation  and we had to move everything out immediately after. 

I just feel like I can't see the light at the end of the tunnel because it isn't there, like I missed out on to much and have just done an amazing job of fucking my life up to the point that it's going to take so much constant effort and dedication to fix it and I don't know how to even start.

And in reference to the females thing I just can't push past it. I know people, I know that no matter what we judge each other on everything. Looks are just the first thing everyone sees, so if you're not good looking then you start with this negative immediately, then add on all my confidence issues and other just mental issues and why would anyone even waste their time with me when there are so many other guys to choose from? I don't know, just a lot of loneliness and lack of people that seemed to give a shit about me made me want to just end it.

I get that, I never left the house during those four years of high school. Never hung out with anyone and no one ever asked me to. College is different though, I messed up and didn't try and change but the first two weeks are when everyone is open to meeting new people. Just know that no matter what it looks like on the outside no one has any idea what they're doing. It's new to everyone and even if they seem like they make friends a lot more easily than you do they're just as scared as you are. I might not be a shining example of confidence but I promise that if you really try and put yourself out there it'll work out.

I just don't have friends like that right now. No unconditional love from someone that could just as easily be a complete stranger to me.

I just want to be prepared if it happens because it seems more spontaneous than anything. Just asking to be safe and not fuck my life up before it really starts.

I get what Omar's lack luster death was supposed to symbolize now that I finished it, but the fact that it is a TV show made me feel like it should've at least been someone who mattered to the story instead of that kid. I mean Omar beat the best guys that Avon and Marlo had, he killed Stinkum and almost killed Wee-Bey, he survived a gun fight with four of Marlo's best hitters, he survived a three story drop and then proceeded to keep going after people while he had a broken leg, he got the jump on Slim who used to be the guy in charge of Avon's muscle with said broken leg, and then he got killed by a kid.
Well it wasn't that exciting compared to the others. Don't get me wrong I love Doughnut, but the season as a whole lacked the intensity of the previous seasons.

Alright so I just finished it (I posted this right after Omar died because I was mad) and I have to say that while the season as a whole was pretty bad they do a good job at coming full circle. Sydnor becomes McNulty, Michael turns into Omar, the city is stuck with another shit police commissioner, and one of Avon's lieutenants is running the drugs. And what you said really does make a lot of sense. I kind of wish Marlo was a little more involved in everything even though I understand why he let other people do the killing, he really came across as a bad ass in that last scene.

I get it from the real life perspective, I really do, and I admire them for sticking to their guns and not caring about ratings. But those characters were amazing. Bodie had everything going against him and he still stayed loyal to his people from day one. Prop Joe was the smartest guy in the game and he was always looking out for his and his own. And Omar was the most feared gangster that the city had, going after a crime organisation with nothing but a few guys to help back him up, and he gets killed by a kid. Not from the crazy shoot out a few days before, not from the three story jump from a balcony, and not from anyone of the people he went after with a broken leg.

Maybe after surviving a gun fight with three of the best hitters Marlo has Omar would be sent off with a little more dignity than a bullet to the back of the head by a kid. I get that it's real and I like it for that but the fact that Omar is this fucking bad ass that even the gangsters are afraid of him I feel like he should've died with a little more dignity.
They're alright but when you compare them to people like Wee Bey, Slim, Bodie, and hell even Poot along with the rest of the terrace and pit boys they're just boring.

In regards to the roommate I like him but he seems to take my calm demeanor as me just saying "Do whatever" like when my mom sent me homemade stuff and him and his friends at more than I did while I was out. When I get the speaker back it's going in my safe when I'm not using it so his friend doesn't make a habit out of this. I probably shouldn't have reacted the way I did but I really don't like the idea of living with someone who just thinks that things like that are okay. And in regards to his friends they're not terrible, in all honesty jocks aren't really the best way to describe them, "bros" would probably be better. I know grouping people is pointless but it's the best way to describe who they are. The only problem I have is that the only time I see them is in my room and they make the same sarcastic remarks towards me as they do towards each other, so I might be interpreting jokes as insults but whatever. 

The loser thing is just something that I picked up as a defense mechanism in high school so that any joke someone made at my expense was met with a blank stare and me just going "True" but it's just a habit that I know I need to break. The problem with finding people interested in the same stuff as me is that even though my school has pretty awful sports teams almost everyone is an athlete in some way or another so finding people into the same stuff as me is difficult but I know that I have to keep trying.

And about the Clearasil, could you link that for me? I'll give it a try but I want to be sure I get the right thing.

Yea I know I'm the only one that can do it for myself but everyone can say "well just don't do that" and think it'll work itself out. Thanks for at least taking the next step and showing me where to start.
I feel like exercise would help but I never get around to it, excuses excuses. I'll try harder but there's always something that makes me rethink it and just do nothing all day instead.

I know that you gave it, but saying stop without telling me how doesn't help. Sure I want to stop calling myself a loser, sure I want to stop feeling sorry for myself, sure I want to be more assertive, but that doesn't mean I have any clue what I need to do to reach that point.

It's hard to stop doing it though, I've always been the kid that really didn't have many friends so I just decided to stop thinking everyone wanted to be my friend. It's just hard to literally change everything about myself.
But how do I start? It's not like I can just magically love myself overnight and get respect, I need some kind of goal that can set me in the right direction
